methods.name: contiguous_out_arg
methods.description: Returns a contiguous tensor or a borrowed reference if already contiguous.

methods.description: Computes the cumulative minimum along a specified dimension on CUDA.

methods.description: Computes the log-cumulative sum of exponentials along a dimension on CUDA.
